original.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 log messages have been augmented with better contextual structured data, which may break tooling that matches on literal strings in log lines.

decision.reason: [ev-775b7a64f057] says cert-manager's log messages now carry better contextual structured data and that matching on literal log strings may break. That describes the same configuration producing different runtime output, so behavior-changed is the right change type. No other family fits runtime log output, so protocol-behavior is the closest available family. The name "log-message-structured-data" is built only from the evidence's own key words.
